mediaPolicy: Each scene uses its matching Creative Commons photograph, keeps visible credit, and labels added motion as interpretive.

scenes.title: Jacarandas at departure
scenes.interpretation: Animated blooms are an interpretive overlay on the credited Pretoria photograph.

scenes.title: The city rises
scenes.interpretation: The rising blocks are an interpretive skyline overlay; no quoted person or mining claim is implied.

scenes.title: Into Kimberley's Big Hole
scenes.interpretation: A photographic camera push toward the flooded crater is interpretive; the small headgear outline adds mining context.

scenes.title: Lines from a junction
scenes.interpretation: The fanning lines are symbolic and are not presented as surveyed railway geometry or an operational claim.

scenes.title: Life beneath the Karoo
scenes.interpretation: The interpretive generic fossil silhouette represents palaeontology; it does not identify a species, formation or date.

scenes.title: Lamps across a lifetime
scenes.interpretation: Warm lamps and building outlines are interpretive overlays, not an architectural reconstruction.

scenes.title: Across the Hex River valley
scenes.interpretation: The moving switchbacks are interpretive and are not presented as actual railway geometry.

scenes.title: Mountain, then city
scenes.interpretation: The mountain profile and lights are interpretive overlays on the credited Cape Town photograph.
